deep.reconstruction:
There is no mathematics on this page. Folio 43r is a slip of bibliographic notes in pencil, with nothing to reconstruct or verify.

The upper block reads:
- "Ann. de Ch. & de Ph. 3 XVII": Annales de Chimie et de Physique, 3e série, vol. XVII (about 1846). The numeral is boxed.
- "vd. P. Ann. 74. p 528. (Jamin)": see Poggendorff's Annalen der Physik und Chemie, vol. 74 (1848), p. 528, a paper by Jules Jamin. The volume and page are underlined.
- An unclear small mark, perhaps a tick or connective sign.
- "Phil. Mag. 1853 Vol. VI p. 81": Philosophical Magazine, 4th series, vol. 6 (1853), p. 81.

The lower block repeats and extends the list:
- "Ann de Ch. & de Ph. – Chem."
- "Phil. Mag", with a correction near the year (1852 is struck or overwritten) and an interlinear abbreviation, possibly "Phys. Zeits." or similar.
- "Comptes rendus 29 (30. 31)", dated "1849. 1850".
- "London & Ed. Phil. Mag Vol. 6 1853".

Interpretation (mine, tentative): Jamin published in exactly these venues around 1847–1850 on the reflection of light at metallic and transparent surfaces and on elliptic polarization by reflection. These include notes in the Comptes rendus 29–31, memoirs in the Ann. Chim. Phys. 3e série, and German translations in Poggendorff's Annalen. The list is therefore most likely a reading list on optical reflection, which Riemann was collecting in 1853.

The previous folio contains manipulations of ε = (√(aδ) − √(bc)) / (√(aδ) + √(bc)), a quotient of the type found in reflection and transmission coefficients. That could connect it to this optical literature, but the link is speculative. The later items on the previous folio, a characteristic-coordinate equation u_pq + u = 0 with a Green-type integral identity, belong to separate work.
